units.slavonic_incipit: Въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ на ма́лѣй вече́рни, на
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в субботу на малей вечерни на гди воззвах
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ на ма́лѣй вече́рни, на гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, стїхи̑ры крⷭ҇та̀ д҃: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи́ра воскресна є҆ди́на, и҆ пра́здника г҃, самогла́сны: стїхо́вна вели́кїѧ вече́рни, съ припѣ́вы и҆́хъ: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. По трїст҃о́мъ тропа́рь воскрⷭ҇нъ, Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. Є҆кте́нїа, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. На вели́цѣй вече́рни, Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ, каѳі́сма всѧ̀. На гди воззва́хъ стїхи̑ры воскрⷭ҇ны, г҃: и҆ крⷭ҇та̀ по, г҃: и҆ пра́ по, г҃, на д҃. Сла́ва крⷭ҇та̀, гла́съ, г҃: Хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е на́шъ. И҆ ны́нѣ пра́дника, гла́съ, ѕ҃: По́сланъ бы́сть: та́же вхо́дъ. и҆ чте́нїѧ є҆́. На лїті́и стїхи̑ры пра́здника, самогла́сны г҃, гла́съ, а҃: и҆ крⷭ҇та̀, г҃: пи́саны на хвали́техъ. Сла́ва пра́здника, и҆ ны́нѣ креста̀: На стїхо́внѣ воскрⷭ҇ны, по а҆лфави́тꙋ. Сла́ва креста̀: и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника: На бл҃гослове́нїи хлѣ́бѡвъ тропа́рь пра́здника, в҃: и҆ крⷭ҇та̀, а҃. и҆ чте́нїе въ посла́нїихъ а҆пⷭ҇лскихъ, и҆лѝ пра́здника.
units.english_cohort_translation: *At Great Vespers, "Blessed is the man," the entire Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, 3; and of the Cross, 3 Podobna; and of the Feast, 4 Podobna. Glory, of the Cross, Tone 3: "O Christ our God;" both now, of the Feast, Tone 6: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Then the Entrance, and 5 readings. At the Litiya, Stichera of the Feast, 3 Idiomela, Tone 1; and of the Cross, 3 (written at the Praises). Glory, of the Feast; both now, of the Cross. At the Aposticha, the Resurrectional [Stichera] according to the alphabet. Glory, of the Cross; both now, of the Feast. At the blessing of the loaves, Troparion...* of the Feast, twice; and of the Cross, once; and reading from the Apostolic Epistles, or of the Feast.

На гди воззва́хъ стїхи̑ры воскрⷭ҇ны, г҃: и҆ крⷭ҇та̀ по, г҃: и҆ пра́ по, г҃, на д҃. Сла́ва крⷭ҇та̀, гла́съ, г҃: Хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е на́шъ. И҆ ны́нѣ пра́дника, гла́съ, ѕ҃: По́сланъ бы́сть: та́же вхо́дъ. и҆ чте́нїѧ є҆́. На лїті́и стїхи̑ры пра́здника, самогла́сны г҃, гла́съ, а҃: и҆ крⷭ҇та̀, г҃: пи́саны на хвали́техъ. units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Polyeleos, and all the Sessional Hymns of the Feast, once each; Glory, both now, of the Feast. And reading of the Feast. Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi] of the Tone. Prokeimenon of the Feast. "Let every breath praise the Lord," and Gospel of the Feast. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ;" Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon: Resurrectional with Heirmos on 4; and of the Cross on 4; and of the Feast on 6. Katavasia of the Feast: "I shall open my mouth." After Ode 3, Kontakion of the Cross, and Ikos; then Sessional Hymns of the Cross; Glory, both now, of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos; and the Prologue. At Ode 9 we sing "More honorable than the Cherubim." Exapostilarion: Resurrectional; Glory, of the Cross; both now, of the Feast.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises, Resurrectional Stichera, 4; and of the Feast, 3, Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the heavenly ranks" (Небе́сныхъ чинѡ́въ); and an Idiomelon, Tone 2: "The mystery which is from the ages;" with their refrains. Then the refrain: "Arise, O Lord my God;"[^378] and we sing the Idiomelon Sticheron of the day. Glory, the same; both now: "Thou art most blessed." Great Doxology. And the order of the veneration of the Cross takes place according to custom; and after this, litanies, and dismissal. Glory, both now, the Evangelical Sticheron; and the Catechesis of St. Theodore the Studite; and the 1st Hour in the narthex.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Sunday at Small Vespers, Stichera of the Feast, on 4; Glory, both now, of the Feast. At the Aposticha, the Idiomelon of the Triodion of the day, twice, and the Martyrikon; Glory, both now, of the Feast. Troparion of the Feast. Little litany, and dismissal. At Great Vespers, after the customary psalm, we sing "Blessed is the man," the 1st antiphon. At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 10: of the Triodion, 3; and of the Feast, 7. Glory, both now: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; and 3 readings of the Feast. And after this the litany: "Let us all say;" then "Vouchsafe, O Lord;" "Let us complete our evening prayer." At the Litiya, Stichera of the Feast; Glory, both now, of the Feast. At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Feast, with the refrains of the Feast; Glory, both now, of the Feast. At the blessing of the loaves: Troparion of the Feast, thrice; and reading of the Feast. At Matins we sing the service of the Feast, as was indicated above for a fasting day in course.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ недѣ́лю на ма́лѣй вече́рнѣ, стїхи̑ры пра́здника на д҃: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. At Great Vespers, after the customary psalm, we sing "Blessed is the man," the 1st antiphon. At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 10: of the Triodion, 3; and of the Feast, 7. Glory, both now: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; and 3 readings of the Feast. And after this the litany: "Let us all say;" then "Vouchsafe, O Lord;" "Let us complete our evening prayer." At the Litiya, Stichera of the Feast; Glory, both now, of the Feast. At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Feast, with the refrains of the Feast; Glory, both now, of the Feast. At the blessing of the loaves: Troparion of the Feast, thrice; and reading of the Feast. At Matins we sing the service of the Feast, as was indicated above for a fasting day in course.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ, на ма́лѣй вече́рни, стїхи̑ры пра́здника, на д҃: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи́ра воскре́сна є҆ди́на, и҆ пра́здника стїхо́вна вели́кїѧ вече́рни: съ припѣ́вы и҆́хъ. Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. Тропа́рь пра́здника, є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. На вели́цѣй вече́рни Блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ, каѳі́сма всѧ̀. На гди воззва́хъ стїхи̑ры воскре́сны, г҃: и҆ восто́ченъ, а҃: и҆ пра́здника, ѕ҃. Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ, ѕ҃: По́сланъ бы́сть. Вхо́дъ. прокі́менъ днѐ: и҆ чте́нїи пра́здника є҆́. На лїті́и стїхи̑ры пра. Сла́ва, гла́съ, н҃: и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ, в҃. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи̑ры воскре́сны. Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. На бл҃гослове́нїи хлѣ́бѡвъ, тропа́рь пра́здника, г҃. и҆ чте́нїе въ посла́нїихъ а҆пⷭ҇лскихъ, и҆лѝ пра́здника. На оу҆́тренни на Бг҃ъ гдⷭ҇ь тропа́рь воскре́нъ, два́жды: Сла́ва
units.english_cohort_translation: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord," the Resurrectional Troparion, twice; Glory...* both now, of the Feast. After the Kathismata, Resurrectional Sessional Hymns with their Theotokia; and reading in the Commentary Gospel. Then the Polyeleos, and all the Sessional Hymns of the Feast, once each; and reading of the Feast. Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi] of the Tone. Prokeimenon of the Feast. "Let every breath praise the Lord," and Gospel of the Feast. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ;" Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon: Resurrectional with Heirmos on 4; and of the Triodion on 4; and of the Feast on 6. Katavasia: the Heirmos of the Feast. After Ode 3, Sessional Hymn of the Feast; Glory, both now, the same; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos; and we read the Prologue. At Ode 9 we sing "More honorable than the Cherubim." Exapostilarion: Resurrectional, and of the Feast. At the Praises, Stichera on 8: Resurrectional, 4; and of the Feast, 4, with their refrains, and with the Doxasticon; then the refrain: "Arise, O Lord my God;"[^379] and we sing the Idiomelon Sticheron of the day; Glory, the same again; both now: "Thou art most blessed." Great Doxology. After the Trisagion, Resurrectional Troparion; litanies, and dismissal. Then Glory, both now, the Evangelical Sticheron. And holy oil is given unto the brethren from the lamp of the All-Holy Birthgiver of God, while we sing the Idiomelon Sticheron of the Feast; and the procession into the narthex; and the 1st Hour. At the 1st Hour, the Resurrectional Troparion; Glory, of the Feast; both now, Theotokion of the Hours. After the Trisagion, Kontakion of the Feast; and the rest, and the complete dismissal.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *We sing the service of the Forefeast of the Annunciation, the Stichera and Canon, on Monday in course; and the Menaion of the Saint we sing at Compline. For the Great Canon is transferred from Thursday to Tuesday of the same week; and we sing the Great Canon with the Tuesday Tri-ode, for the sake of the feast of the Most Holy Mother of God: for on Wednesday, on the feast itself, no Kathisma is said, and no prostrations are made. After "Let my prayer arise," 3 prostrations; and the rest of the Presanctified; and at "Blessed be the name of the Lord,"[^380] 3 prostrations; and at the dismissal, 3 prostrations.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Note: And at the 1st hour of the night, the great bell is struck, and then all of them. And having gathered into the temple, the priest having given the blessing, we sing Great Compline. And the priest censes as is the custom. And after "Glory to God in the highest," we go forth into the narthex, and make the customary Litiya, and sing 3 Idiomela Stichera of the Feast, Tone 1; Glory, both now: "Gabriel announces good tidings;" and the customary prayer of the Vigil from the priest; and upon concluding, we enter again into the temple. And we sing at the Aposticha the Idiomela Stichera with their refrains. Glory, both now: "Today is the joy of the Annunciation." At the blessing of the loaves, Troparion of the Feast, thrice; and reading of the Feast.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Feast, thrice. After the 1st Kathisma, the Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader,"[^381] and 3 others, and 3 Ikoses; and again the 1st Kontakion; and reading of the Akathist. After the 2nd Kathisma, 3 Kontakia, and 3 Ikoses; and again the 1st Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader," as was shown before; and reading of the Akathist; and the Polyeleos; and all the Sessional Hymns of the Feast; and reading of the Feast.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi], the 1st antiphon of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon of the Feast. "Let every breath praise the Lord;" Gospel of the Feast. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon of the Feast with Heirmos on 8; and of the Akathist on 6. Katavasia of the Feast, both choirs together. But the Four-ode Canon we do not sing here; rather we sing it beforehand, on Thursday at Compline. After Ode 3, 3 Kontakia, and 3 Ikoses; and again the 1st Kontakion. After this, Sessional Hymn, and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, 3 Kontakia, and 3 Ikoses; then the Kontakion: "O all-hymned Mother," thrice; and the 1st Ikos; and the Kontakion: "To thee, the Champion Leader;" and we read the Prologue, and the Synaxarion. At Ode 9 we do not sing "More honorable than the Cherubim," but we sing the refrains of the Feast, as was indicated for the Feast itself. Unto the troparia of the Canon of the Akathist the refrain is: "Most Holy Mother of God, save us." Then at the Katavasia we sing the refrain and the Heirmos: "As the animate ark of God;" and a bow. Exapostilarion of the Feast. At the Praises, Stichera of the Feast, Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the heavenly ranks" (Небе́сныхъ чинѡ́въ), on 4; Glory, both now: "Let the heavens be glad;" Great Doxology; Troparion of the Feast; litanies, and dismissal. And holy oil is given unto the brethren according to custom; and the Catechesis of St. Theodore the Studite; and the 1st Hour in the narthex.*

units.slavonic_incipit: Прокі́менъ пра́здника. Всѧ́кое дыха́нїе: Є҆ѵа́ггелїе пра́здника.
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: прокимен праздника всякое дыхание еиаггелие праздника псалом н
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Степе́нна а҃-й а҆нтїфѡ́нъ, д҃-гѡ гла́са. Прокі́менъ пра́здника. Всѧ́кое дыха́нїе: Є҆ѵа́ггелїе пра́здника. Ѱало́мъ, н҃. Стїхи́ра, пра́здника. Канѡ́нъ пра́здника, со і҆рмосо́мъ на и҃: и҆ а҆ка́ѳїста, на ѕ҃. Катава́сїа пра́здника, ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. Четверобѣ́сница же здѣ̀ не пое́мъ: но пое́мъ напредѝ, въ четверто́къ на повече́рїи. По г҃-й пѣ́сни кондакѝ г҃: и҆ і҆́косы г҃: и҆ па́ки конда́къ а҃-й. Посе́мъ сѣда́ленъ: и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни кондакѝ г҃: и҆ і҆́косы г҃: Та́же конда́къ, Ѡ҆ всепѣ́таѧ мт҃и, г҃: и҆ і҆́косъ а҃-й: и҆ конда́къ, Взбра́нной воево́дѣ: и҆ чте́мъ про́логъ, и҆ сѷнаѯа́рїй. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни Честнѣ́йшꙋю не пое́мъ: но пое́мъ припѣ́вы пра́здника, ꙗ҆́коже предписа́сѧ на са́мый пра́здникъ. Къ тропарє́мъ же канѡ́на а҆ка́ѳїста припѣ́въ: Прест҃а́ѧ бц҃е спаси́ на́съ. Та́же на схо́дѣ пое́мъ припѣ́въ, и҆ і҆рмо́съ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆дꙋшевленно́мꙋ: и҆ покло́нъ. Свѣти́ленъ пра́здника. На хвали́тїхъ стїхи̑ры пра́здника, гла́съ, а҃. подо́бенъ: Небе́сныхъ чинѡ́въ, на д҃. Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ: Да веселя́тсѧ нб҃са̀: Славосло́вїе вели́кое. тропа́рь пра́здника. є҆кте́нїи, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ дае́тсѧ бра́тїи ст҃ы́й є҆ле́й по ѻ҆бы́чаю. и҆ ѡ҆глаше́нїе стꙋді́тово. и҆ ча́съ а҃, въ притво́рѣ.

And holy oil is given unto the brethren according to custom; and the Catechesis of St. Theodore the Studite; and the 1st Hour in the narthex.*

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source: Степе́нна а҃-й а҆нтїфѡ́нъ, д҃-гѡ гла́са. Прокі́менъ пра́здника. Всѧ́кое дыха́нїе: Є҆ѵа́ггелїе пра́здника. Ѱало́мъ, н҃. Стїхи́ра, пра́здника. Канѡ́нъ пра́здника, со і҆рмосо́мъ на и҃: и҆ а҆ка́ѳїста, на ѕ҃. Катава́сїа пра́здника, ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. Четверобѣ́сница же здѣ̀ не пое́мъ: но пое́мъ напредѝ, въ четверто́къ на повече́рїи. По г҃-й пѣ́сни кондакѝ г҃: и҆ і҆́косы г҃: и҆ па́ки конда́къ а҃-й. Посе́мъ сѣда́ленъ: и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни кондакѝ г҃: и҆ і҆́косы г҃: Та́же конда́къ, Ѡ҆ всепѣ́таѧ мт҃и, г҃: и҆ і҆́косъ а҃-й: и҆ конда́къ, Взбра́нной воево́дѣ: и҆ чте́мъ про́логъ, и҆ сѷнаѯа́рїй. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни Честнѣ́йшꙋю не пое́мъ: но пое́мъ припѣ́вы пра́здника, ꙗ҆́коже предписа́сѧ на са́мый пра́здникъ. Къ тропарє́мъ же канѡ́на а҆ка́ѳїста припѣ́въ: Прест҃а́ѧ бц҃е спаси́ на́съ. Та́же на схо́дѣ пое́мъ припѣ́въ, и҆ і҆рмо́съ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆дꙋшевленно́мꙋ: и҆ покло́нъ. Свѣти́ленъ пра́здника. На хвали́тїхъ стїхи̑ры пра́здника, гла́съ, а҃. подо́бенъ: Небе́сныхъ чинѡ́въ, на д҃. Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ: Да веселя́тсѧ нб҃са̀: Славосло́вїе вели́кое. тропа́рь пра́здника. є҆кте́нїи, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ дае́тсѧ бра́тїи ст҃ы́й є҆ле́й по ѻ҆бы́чаю. и҆ ѡ҆глаше́нїе стꙋді́тово. и҆ ча́съ а҃, въ притво́рѣ.

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Friday evening, we say no Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried," the Idiomelon Sticheron of the day, twice: "Having accomplished the forty days to our soul's profit,"[^382] the short one; and of the Feast, 3: "The eternal counsel;" and of Saint Lazarus, 5. Glory: "Having accomplished the forty days to our soul's profit," the long one; both now, of the Feast: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance; Prokeimenon, and reading of the day; and of the Feast, 5 readings; and the rest of the Presanctified. In the refectory, dispensation for wine and oil.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Note: And at the 1st hour of the night, the great bell is struck sufficiently, and then all of them. And having gathered into the temple, we sing Great Compline. After the 1st Trisagion, Troparion of the Feast. After the 2nd, Kontakion of the Feast. And after "Glory to God in the highest," the procession into the narthex. And we sing 3 Idiomela Stichera of the Feast, and 3 Idiomela of the Triodion (written at the Praises: "Wishing to show forth the glory of Thy Godhead, O Christ");[^383] Glory: "Let the heavens be glad;" both now: "Gabriel announces good tidings." At the Aposticha, the Idiomela Stichera of the Feast, with their refrains. Glory...*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Feast, twice; Glory: "The general Resurrection;" both now, of the Feast. After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn of the Triodion, Tone 1: "Having had compassion on the tears of Martha and Mary," twice; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading concerning Lazarus. After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn of the Triodion, Tone 5: "The fountain of wisdom," twice; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading concerning righteous Lazarus, or of the Feast. Then Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymn of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Gospel of the Feast. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ;" and Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 6; and of Saint Lazarus, both canons on 8; likewise also the four-ode canon. Katavasia of the 2nd canon of Lazarus, Heirmos: "Having traversed the water," both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of Saint Lazarus; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast and Ikos, and reading. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the Refrain of the Feast, as was prescribed on the Feast itself. And to the canon of the Triodion we say the refrain: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee." Katavasia: "Truly the Mother of God;" then Refrain of the Feast, and Heirmos: "As the animate [Ark];" after this: "Holy is the Lord our God," in Tone 1. Exapostilarion of the Feast, twice; Glory and both now, of Lazarus. At the Praises, Stichera of the Feast, 3; and of Lazarus, 3. Then the refrains: "Arise, O Lord my God;"[^384] and "I will give thanks unto Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart."[^385] Glory, of Saint Lazarus: "A great and marvelous [wonder];" both now, of the Feast: "The mystery hidden from the ages." Great Doxology. Troparion of the Feast; Glory and both now: "The general Resurrection." Litanies, and dismissal; and catechesis; and the 1st Hour, in the narthex: Troparion of the Feast; Glory: "The general Resurrection;" both now, Theotokion of the Hours. After "Our Father," Kontakion of Lazarus. Thus we say the Troparia on the other Hours as well; the Kontakia we alternate. And at the 2nd hour of the day, we make the procession outside the monastery. (Note: And having returned, we sing the Hours.) At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 3 on 4; and of Lazarus, Ode 6 on 4. After the Entrance, Troparion of the Feast, and of Lazarus; Glory, Kontakion of Lazarus; both now, of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagion, we sing: "As many as have been baptized into Christ." Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel, first of the Feast, then of Lazarus.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: на утренни на бг гд тропар праздника в
units.slavonic_diplomatic: На ᲂу҆́тренни на Бг҃ъ гдⷭь, тропа́рь пра́здника, в҃: Сла́ва, Ѻ҆́бщее воскр҃се́нїе: И҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. По а҃-й каѳі́смѣ сѣда́ленъ трїѡ́ди, гла́съ, а҃: Оу҆ще́дривъ Марѳины и҆ Марї́ины сле́зы: в҃: Сл҃а и҆ нн҃ѣ пра́здника. и҆ чте́нїе ѡ҆ Лазарѣ̀. По в҃-й каѳі́смѣ, сѣда́ленъ трїѡ́ди, гла́съ е҃: Исто́чникъ премꙋ́дрости: в҃. Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. и҆ чте́нїе ѡ҆ пра́ведномъ Ла́зарѣ, и҆лѝ пра́здника. Та́же полѷеле́й, и҆ сѣда́ленъ пра́здника. и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. Степе́нна а҃-й а҆нті́фѡнъ, д҃-гѡ гла́са. Прокі́менъ, є҆ѵⷢлїе пра́здника. Воскр҃се́нїе Хрⷭто́во. и҆ ѱало́мъ н҃. стіхи́ра пра́здника. Канѡ́нъ пра́здника со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃: и҆ ст҃а́гѡ Ла́зарѧ ѻ҆́ба канѡ́на на и҃: Та́кожде и҆ четверомѣ́сница. Катава́сїа в҃-гѡ канѡ́на ла́зарева, і҆рмо́съ: Во́дꙋ проше́дъ: ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. По г҃-й пѣ́сни, конда́къ, и҆ і҆́косъ, и҆ сѣда́ленъ ст҃а́гѡ Ла́зарѧ. Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника: и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни, конда́къ пра́здника, и҆ і҆́косъ, и҆ чте́нїе. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни Чтнѣ́йшꙋю не пое́мъ, но пое́мъ припѣ́въ пра́здника, ꙗ҆́коже предписа́сѧ на са́мый пра́здникъ. Къ трїѡ́ди же канѡ́на глаго́лемъ припѣ́въ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Катава́сїа: Вои́стиннꙋ Бцⷣꙋ: Та́же припѣ́въ пра́здника; и҆ і҆рмо́съ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆дꙋшевлє́нномꙋ: по се́мъ: Ст҃ъ Гдⷭь Бг҃ъ на́шъ: на гла́съ а҃. Свѣти́ленъ пра́здника, в҃: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, Ла́зарѧ. На хвали́техъ стіхи̑ры, пра́здника, г҃: и҆ Ла́зарѧ, г҃. Та́же припѣ́вы: Воскрⷭнѝ Гдⷭи Бж҃е мо́й. и҆ И҆сповѣ́мсѧ тебѣ̀ Гдⷭи всѣ́мъ срⷣцемъ мои́мъ: Сла́ва, ст҃а́гѡ Ла́зарѧ: Ве́лїе и҆ пресла́вное: И҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника: Е҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка та́инство. Славосло́вїе вели́кое. тропа́рь, прл: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ: Ѻ҆́бщее воскр҃се́нїе: є҆кте́нїи, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. и҆ ѡ҆глаше́нїе: и҆ ча́съ а҃-й, въ притво́рѣ: тропа́рь пра́здника. Сла́ва, Ѻ҆́бщее воскр҃се́нїе: и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ часѡ́въ: По Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: конда́къ Ла́зарѧ. Си́це тропарѝ гл҃емъ, и҆ на про́чихъ часѣ́хъ. кондакѝ премѣнѧ́емъ. При часѣ́ же в҃-мъ днѐ твори́мъ и҆схожде́нїе внѣ̀ монастырѧ̀: Зрѝ возвра́щшесѧ же пое́мъ часы̀. На лїтꙋргі́и блаже́нна пра́здника, пѣ́снь г҃-ѧ, на д҃: и҆ Ла́зарѧ пѣ́снь ѕ҃-ѧ, на д҃. По вхо́дѣ, тропа́рь пра́здника, и҆ Ла́зарѧ. Сла́ва, конда́къ Ла́зарѧ: и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника. Вмѣ́стѡ Трⷭта́гѡ пое́мъ: Є҆ли́цы во Хрⷭта̀ крⷭти́стесѧ. Прокі́менъ, а҆пл҃ъ, а҆λληлꙋ́їа, и҆ є҆ѵⷢлїе, пре́жде пра́здника, та́же Ла́зарѧ.

На хвали́техъ стіхи̑ры, пра́здника, г҃: и҆ Ла́зарѧ, г҃. Та́же припѣ́вы: Воскрⷭнѝ Гдⷭи Бж҃е мо́й. и҆ И҆сповѣ́мсѧ тебѣ̀ Гдⷭи всѣ́мъ срⷣцемъ мои́мъ: Сла́ва, ст҃а́гѡ Ла́зарѧ: Ве́лїе и҆ пресла́вное: И҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника: Е҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка та́инство. Славосло́вїе вели́кое. тропа́рь, прл: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ: Ѻ҆́бщее воскр҃се́нїе: є҆кте́нїи, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. и҆ ѡ҆глаше́нїе: и҆ ча́съ а҃-й, въ притво́рѣ: тропа́рь пра́здника. Сла́ва, Ѻ҆́бщее воскр҃се́нїе: и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ часѡ́въ: По Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ: конда́къ Ла́зарѧ. Си́це тропарѝ гл҃емъ, и҆ на про́чихъ часѣ́хъ. кондакѝ премѣнѧ́емъ. При часѣ́ же в҃-мъ днѐ твори́мъ и҆схожде́нїе внѣ̀ монастырѧ̀: Зрѝ возвра́щшесѧ же пое́мъ часы̀. На лїтꙋргі́и блаже́нна пра́здника, пѣ́снь г҃-ѧ, на д҃: и҆ Ла́зарѧ пѣ́снь ѕ҃-ѧ, на д҃. По вхо́дѣ, тропа́рь пра́здника, и҆ Ла́зарѧ. Сла́ва, конда́къ Ла́зарѧ: и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника. Вмѣ́стѡ Трⷭта́гѡ пое́мъ: Є҆ли́цы во Хрⷭта̀ крⷭти́стесѧ. Прокі́менъ, а҆пл҃ъ, а҆λληлꙋ́їа, и҆ є҆ѵⷢлїе, пре́жде пра́здника, та́же Ла́зарѧ.
units.english_text: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Feast, twice; Glory: "The general Resurrection;" both now, of the Feast. After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn of the Triodion, Tone 1: "Having had compassion on the tears of Martha and Mary," twice; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading concerning Lazarus. After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn of the Triodion, Tone 5: "The fountain of wisdom," twice; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading concerning righteous Lazarus, or of the Feast. Then Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymn of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Gospel of the Feast. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ;" and Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 6; and of Saint Lazarus, both canons on 8; likewise also the four-ode canon. Katavasia of the 2nd canon of Lazarus, Heirmos: "Having traversed the water," both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of Saint Lazarus; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast and Ikos, and reading. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the Refrain of the Feast, as was prescribed on the Feast itself. And to the canon of the Triodion we say the refrain: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee." Katavasia: "Truly the Mother of God;" then Refrain of the Feast, and Heirmos: "As the animate [Ark];" after this: "Holy is the Lord our God," in Tone 1. Exapostilarion of the Feast, twice; Glory and both now, of Lazarus. At the Praises, Stichera of the Feast, 3; and of Lazarus, 3. Then the refrains: "Arise, O Lord my God;"[^384] and "I will give thanks unto Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart."[^385] Glory, of Saint Lazarus: "A great and marvelous [wonder];" both now, of the Feast: "The mystery hidden from the ages." Great Doxology. Troparion of the Feast; Glory and both now: "The general Resurrection." Litanies, and dismissal; and catechesis; and the 1st Hour, in the narthex: Troparion of the Feast; Glory: "The general Resurrection;" both now, Theotokion of the Hours. After "Our Father," Kontakion of Lazarus. Thus we say the Troparia on the other Hours as well; the Kontakia we alternate. And at the 2nd hour of the day, we make the procession outside the monastery. (Note: And having returned, we sing the Hours.) At the Liturgy, the Beatitudes of the Feast, Ode 3 on 4; and of Lazarus, Ode 6 on 4. After the Entrance, Troparion of the Feast, and of Lazarus; Glory, Kontakion of Lazarus; both now, of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagion, we sing: "As many as have been baptized into Christ." Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel, first of the Feast, then of Lazarus.*

По а҃-й каѳі́смѣ сѣда́ленъ трїѡ́ди, гла́съ, а҃: Оу҆ще́дривъ Марѳины и҆ Марї́ины сле́зы: в҃: Сл҃а и҆ нн҃ѣ пра́здника. и҆ чте́нїе ѡ҆ Лазарѣ̀. Та́же полѷеле́й, и҆ сѣда́ленъ пра́здника. и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. Степе́нна а҃-й а҆нті́фѡнъ, д҃-гѡ гла́са. Прокі́менъ, є҆ѵⷢлїе пра́здника. Воскр҃се́нїе Хрⷭто́во. и҆ ѱало́мъ н҃. стіхи́ра пра́здника. Канѡ́нъ пра́здника со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃: и҆ ст҃а́гѡ Ла́зарѧ ѻ҆́ба канѡ́на на и҃: Та́кожде и҆ четверомѣ́сница. Катава́сїа в҃-гѡ канѡ́на ла́зарева, і҆рмо́съ: Во́дꙋ проше́дъ: ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers, "Blessed is the man," the entire Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Feast, 3, repeating them to 6; and of the Palms, on 4. Glory, of the Palms: "Today the grace [of the Holy Spirit];" both now, of the Feast: "Was sent [the Archangel Gabriel]." Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day, and readings of the Feast, 5; and of the Palms, 3. At the Litiya, Stichera of the Feast, 3; and of the Palms, 3. Glory, of the Palms: "Six days before [the Passover];" both now, of the Feast: "Gabriel announces good tidings." At the Aposticha, Idiomela Stichera of the Palms, Tone 8, with their refrains; Glory, of the Palms: "Today the grace [of the Holy Spirit];" both now, of the Feast: "The mystery hidden from the ages." At the blessing of the loaves, Troparion of the Feast, twice; and of the Palms, once; and reading of the Feast.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ сꙋббѡ́тꙋ на ма́лѣй вече́рни, стіхи̑ры ва́їй, на д҃: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника: Въ шесты́й мц҃ъ: На стіхо́внѣ, самогла́сны пра́здника, вели́кїѧ вече́рни, съ припѣ̑вы и҆́хъ, Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ ва́їи: Пою̀ твоѐ стра́шное. тропа́рь пра́здника: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, Ѻ҆́бщее воскр҃се́нїе. є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. На вели́цѣй вече́рни блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ, каѳі́сма всѧ̀. На Гдⷭи воззва́хъ сті̑хи пра́здника, г҃, повтѡрѧ́юще ѕ҃: и҆ ва́їй на д҃. Сла́ва, ва́їи: Дне́сь бл҃года́ть. И҆ нн҃ѣ, пра́здника: По́сланъ бы́сть: Вхо́дъ. Прокі́менъ днѐ, и҆ чтє́нїѧ пра́здника, є҃: и҆ ва́їй, г҃. На літі́и стіхи̑ры пра́здника, г҃: и҆ ва́їй, г҃. Сла́ва, ва́їй: Пре́жде шестѝ дне́й: И҆ ны́нѣ прл: Бл҃говѣствꙋ́етъ Гаврїи́лъ. На стіхо́внѣ стіхи̑ры самогла́сны ва́їй: гла́съ, н҃: съ припѣ̑вы и҆́хъ. Сла́ва, ва́їи: Дне́сь бл҃года́ть: и҆ нн҃ѣ пра́здника: Е҆́же ѡ҆ вѣ́ка та́инство. На бл҃гослове́нїи хлѣ́бѡвъ: тропа́рь пра́здника, в҃: и҆ ва́їи, а҃. и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. На ᲂу҆́тренни на Бг҃ъ Гдⷭь, тропа́рь пра́здника в҃: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ: Ѻ҆́бщее воскр҃се́нїе. По а҃-й каѳі́смѣ, ст҃ ва́їи, Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника: и҆ чте́нїе. По в҃-й каѳі́смѣ, сѣда́ленъ ва́їи: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника: и҆ чте́нїе. Та́же полѷеле́й пра́здника, и҆ сѣда́льны, и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. Степе́нна а҃-й а҆нті́фѡнъ, д҃-гѡ гла́са. Прокі́менъ ва́їи. Всѧ́кое дыха́нїе: Є҆ѵⷢлїе ва́їи. Ѱало́мъ н҃. Воскрⷭне́нїе же Хрⷭто́во не глаго́лемъ. И҆ є҆гда̀ цѣлꙋ́ютъ бра́тїа ст҃о́е є҆ѵⷢлїе, раздае́тъ и҆гꙋ́менъ ва́їа, со свѣща́ми бра́тїи, по ѻ҆бы́чаю. Вмѣ́стѡ же, Моли́твами Бцⷣы: Пое́мъ, Сла́ва, Дне́сь Хрⷭто́съ: и҆ нн҃ѣ то́йже. Та́же: Поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ Бж҃е: Посе́мъ стіхи́ра, гла́съ, ѕ҃: Дне́сь бл҃года́ть. Канѡ́нъ пра́здника со і҆рмосо́мъ на и҃: и҆ ва́їи со і҆рмосо́мъ на и҃. Катава́сїа ѻ҆бои́хъ канѡ́нѡвъ, кі́йждо ли́къ сво́й і҆рмо́съ. По г҃ пѣ́сни, конда́къ ва́їи, и҆ і҆́косъ, и҆ сѣда́ленъ: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. И҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни конда́къ пра́здника, и҆ і҆́косъ. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни Честнѣ́йшꙋю не пое́мъ: но пое́мъ припѣ́въ пра́здника, ꙗ҆́кѡ предписа́сѧ. Ва́їи же пое́мъ по ѻ҆бы́чаю, припѣ́въ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. На схо́дѣ же пре́жде пое́мъ припѣ́въ пра́здника: і҆рмо́съ пра́здника: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆дꙋшевлє́нномꙋ: пото́мъ же ва́їи. Та́же: Ст҃ъ Гдⷭь Бг҃ъ на́шъ, на гла́съ, д҃. Свѣти́ленъ Свѣти́ленъ пра́здника, два́жды.
units.english_cohort_translation: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Feast, twice; Glory and both now: "The general Resurrection." After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Palms; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading. After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn of the Palms; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading. Then Polyeleos of the Feast, and Sessional Hymns, and reading of the Feast. Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon of the Palms; "Every breath;" Gospel of the Palms. Psalm 50. But we do not say "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ." And when the brethren kiss the Holy Gospel, the Superior distributes the palms with candles to the brethren, according to the custom. And instead of "Through the intercessions of the Mother of God," we sing: Glory: "Today Christ [enters the holy city];" and both now, the same. Then: "Have mercy on me, O God." After this, Sticheron, Tone 6: "Today the grace [of the Holy Spirit]." Canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 8; and of the Palms with the Heirmos on 8. Katavasia of both canons, each choir its own Heirmos. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the Palms, and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the Refrain of the Feast, as was prescribed. And of the Palms we sing according to custom, with the refrain: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee." And at the Katavasia, we sing first the Refrain of the Feast, and the Heirmos of the Feast: "As the animate [Ark];" and afterwards of the Palms. Then: "Holy is the Lord our God," in Tone 4.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *And at the 2nd hour of the day, we go forth with a Litiya outside the monastery, as was indicated in order; and having returned, we sing the Hours. At the Hours, Troparion of the Feast; Glory: "The general Resurrection;" both now, Theotokion of the Hours. After "Our Father," we alternate the Kontakia. units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers, we sing "Blessed is the man," the 1st Antiphon. At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Feast, on 6; and of the Palms, on 4. Glory, of the Palms, Tone 6: "He who hath heaven as His throne;" both now, of the Feast: "Was sent [the Archangel Gabriel]." Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; readings of the Feast, 3. At the Litiya, Stichera of the Feast; Glory and both now, of the Feast: "Gabriel announces good tidings." At the Aposticha, Stichera of the day, Idiomela, with their refrains; Glory, of the Palms: "From branches and palms;" both now, of the Feast. At the blessing of the loaves, Troparion of the Feast, thrice; and reading of the Feast. At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Feast. After the 1st Kathisma and after the 2nd, Sessional Hymns of the day; and reading of the day. After the 3rd Kathisma, Small Litany. Sessional Hymns of the Feast, both; and reading of the Feast. Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymns, and reading of the Feast. Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon: "Proclaim from day to day;" "Every breath;" Gospel of the Feast. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast.*

units.slavonic_incipit: На вели́цѣй вече́рни пое́мъ блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: на велицей вечерни поем блажен муж а й антифон
units.slavonic_diplomatic: На вели́цѣй вече́рни пое́мъ блаже́нъ мꙋ́жъ, а҃-й а҆нті́фѡнъ. На гдⷭи воззва́хъ, стіхи́ры пра́здника, на ѕ҃: и҆ ва́їи на д҃. Сла́ва ва́їи, гла́съ ѕ: Имѣ́ѧи прⷭто́лъ нб҃о: и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника: По́сланъ бы́сть: Вхо́дъ: прокі́менъ днѐ: чтє́нїа пра́здника, г҃. На літі́и, стіхи̑ры пра́здника, Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника: Бл҃говѣствꙋ́етъ гаврїи́лъ. На стіхо́внѣ стіхи́ры днѐ, самогла́сны, съ припѣ̑вы и҆́хъ: Сла́ва ва́їи: Ѿ вѣ́твїи и҆ ва́їи: и҆ нн҃ѣ пра́з. На бл҃гослове́нїи хлѣ́бѡвъ тропа́рь пра́з, три́жды. и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. На ᲂу҆́тренни на Бг҃ъ Гдⷭь, тропа́рь пра́з. По а҃-й каѳі́смѣ, и҆ по в҃-й, сѣда́льны днѐ: и҆ чте́нїе днѐ. По г҃-й каѳі́смѣ, є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ. Сѣда́лны пра́здника ѻ҆́ба: и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. Полѷеле́й, и҆ сѣда́лны, и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. Степе́нна, а҃-й а҆нті́фѡнъ, д҃-гѡ гла́са. Прокі́менъ: Бл҃говѣсти́те де́нь ѿ днѐ: Всѧ́кое дыха́нїе: Є҆ѵⷢлїе пра́здника. Ѱало́мъ, н҃. Стіхи́ра пра́здника.

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 6; and the Triodion (three-ode canon) on 8. Katavasia of the Triodion: the Heirmos, both choirs together. But where there is no Triodion: we sing the canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 14. Katavasia of the Feast. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the day, and Ikos; and Sessional Hymn of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos. Prologue, and Synaxarion. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the Refrain of the Feast: "Proclaim good tidings, O earth;" then the Heirmos of the Feast: "As the animate [Ark]." To the troparia of the Triodion, the refrain: "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee." Then we sing the Heirmos of the Triodion; afterwards, the Refrain of the Feast, and the Heirmos: "As the animate [Ark]." Exapostilarion of the Feast; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Feast, on 4; Glory, of the Feast: "The mystery hidden from the ages;" both now, of the day: "The withered fig tree." Then the Superior or reader says: "Glory to Thee Who hast shown us the light." Litany: "Let us complete our morning prayer." At the Aposticha, Idiomela Stichera of the day, Tone 1: "The Lord as He comes;" refrain: "We were filled [in the morning with Thy mercy];"[^387] "Having attained, O ye faithful;" refrain: "We have rejoiced for all our days, for the days wherein Thou didst humble us;"[^388] "O Lord, as Thou comest to the Passion;" refrain: "And look upon Thy servants;"[^389] "O Lord, unto the mystery;" refrain: "And let the brightness [of the Lord our God be upon us];"[^390] "O Lord, the most perfect [wisdom]:" Glory, Tone 8: "A second Eve;" both now, of the Feast: "Let the heavens be glad." Then: "It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord,"[^391] twice. After the Trisagion, Troparion of the Feast. Litany; and 3 great prostrations. After this, "O come, let us worship," thrice; and the 1st Hour. Troparion of the Feast; both now, Theotokion: "What shall we call thee?" After the Trisagion, Kontakion of the Feast; and at the end, 3 great prostrations. Then: "O Christ, the true Light;" and dismissal.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *(Note: And at the 3rd hour of the day, we make the Litiya outside the monastery. And having returned, we sing the 3rd Hour and the 6th, with Kathismata and with reading; and we read the Tetra-Gospel. And at them is said the Troparion of the Feast; we alternate the Kontakia of the day and of the Feast. And at the end of each Hour, 3 great prostrations. Likewise we sing also the 9th Hour; and the Beatitudes simply, without singing; and "Remember us, O Lord;" and the rest. After "Our Father," Kontakion of the day; Glory and both now, of the Feast. "Lord, have mercy," 40. Glory and both now: "More honorable;" and 3 great prostrations. Immediately we begin Vespers...)*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...without prostrations, and without a Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried," Idiomela Stichera of the day, 5; and of the Feast, 5; Glory, of the day: "The withered fig tree;" both now, of the Feast: "Was sent [the Archangel Gabriel]." Entrance with the Gospel. "O gladsome Light." Prokeimenon, and readings of the day; and of the Feast, 2. Then Small Litany, and the Trisagion. Prokeimenon, Epistle, and Alleluia, of the Feast; Gospel of the Feast, and of the day. And the rest of the Liturgy of Chrysostom. Communion Hymn of the Feast.*

units.slavonic_incipit: На гдⷭи воззва́хъ, стіхи̑ры на і҃:
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: на гди воззвах стихиры на и и поем
units.slavonic_diplomatic: На гдⷭи воззва́хъ, стіхи̑ры на і҃: и҆ пое́мъ днѐ г҃, гла́съ, а҃. повторѧ́юще первыѧ двѣ̀. и҆ пра́здника, є҃. Сла́ва днѐ, гла́съ, н҃: Второ́ю є҆́ѵꙋ: и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. Вхо́дъ со є҆ѵⷢлїемъ. Свѣ́те ти́хїй. Прокі́менъ, и҆ чте́нїа днѐ: и҆ пра́здника, в҃. Та́же прокі́менъ. а҆пл҃ъ, а҆λληлꙋ́їа, и҆ є҆ѵⷢлїе пра́здника, и҆ днѐ. Сподо́би гдⷭи: є҆ктені́а, И҆спо́лнимъ вече́рнюю: На стіхо́внѣ, днѐ, гла́съ, є҃: Гдⷭи соверше́ннѣйшаѧ мꙋ́дрствовати: два̀, съ припѣ̑вы дневны́ми. Дрꙋгі́й сті́хъ: гла́съ, н҃: И҆зсо́хшїѧ смоко́вницы: Сла́ва. гла́съ, є҃: Гдⷭи грѧды́й ко страда́нїю: и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. Нн҃ѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: тропа́рь пра́здника. є҆ктени́: и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. Си́це пое́мъ и҆ въ про́чыѧ дни̑, стра́стныѧ недѣ́ли. На трапе́зѣ разрѣше́нїе на є҆ле́й и҆ вїно̀ то́чїю. На повече́рїи, покло́нѡвъ нѣ́сть. То́чїю по Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ, г҃ поклоны. На трⷭто́мъ, г҃ покло́ны: въ коне́цъ, г҃ поклоны вели́кїѧ: в҃і, ма́лыхъ. На коне́чномъ трїст҃о́мъ, г҃ поклоны: Пое́мъ же трїпѣ́снецъ ку́ръ А҆ндре́а.

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Monday evening, we do not say a Kathisma. At "Lord, I have cried," Idiomela Stichera of the day, 5; and of the Feast, 5; Glory, of the day: "A second Eve;" both now, of the Feast: "Was sent [the Archangel Gabriel]." Entrance with the Gospel. "O gladsome Light." Prokeimenon, and readings of the day; and of the Feast, 3. "Let my prayer be set forth;"[^392] and 3 prostrations. Gospel of the day; and the rest of the Presanctified. In the refectory, we drink wine.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *(Note: And at the 1st hour of the night, the great bell is struck, and then all of them likewise. And having gathered into the temple, we sing Great Compline. "God is with us:" we sing with both choirs, with chanting. The priest at the beginning censes according to custom. And after "Glory to God in the highest," the procession into the narthex. And we sing at the Litiya the Idiomela Stichera of the Feast; Glory and both now, of the Feast: "Gabriel announces good tidings." At the Aposticha, Stichera...)*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...Idiomela of the Feast, 3, with their refrains; Glory and both now: "Today is joy." At the blessing of the loaves, Troparion of the Feast, thrice; and reading of the Feast. At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Feast, thrice. After both Kathismata, Sessional Hymns of the Triodion; and reading of the day. After the 3rd Kathisma, Small Litany, and Sessional Hymns of the Feast; and reading. Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymn of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon; "Every breath;" Gospel of the Feast. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 14. Katavasia of the Feast: the Heirmos, both choirs together. But where there is a two-ode canon of the Triodion: we sing the canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 6; the two-ode canon on 8. The last Heirmos of the Triodion, both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the day, and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos; and we read the Prologue. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the Refrain and Heirmos of the Feast, as was indicated on Great Monday. Exapostilarion of the Feast; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. At the Praises, Stichera, by [rule]: of the Feast, on 4; Glory, of the day: "With slothfulness of soul;" both now, of the Feast: "The mystery hidden from the ages." At the Aposticha, Idiomela of the day with their refrains, as was prescribed on Monday: "We were filled in the morning;" Glory, of the Feast: "Let the heavens be glad;" both now, of the day, Tone 6: "When Thou shalt come in glory." Troparion of the Feast; Litany; and 3 great prostrations. Then: "O come, let us worship," thrice; the 1st Hour. At the end thereof, 3 great prostrations. And the prayer: "O Christ, the true Light;" and dismissal.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *(Note: And at the 3rd hour of the day, we make the Litiya outside the monastery. And having returned, we sing the Hours with Kathismata; and the Tetra-Gospel is read. We say at the Hours the Troparion of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. The Kontakia we say of the day and of the Feast, alternating them. And at the end of each Hour, 3 great prostrations. And the 9th Hour without a Kathisma. The Beatitudes quickly, without singing; and "Remember us, O Lord;" and the rest, as was prescribed. After "Our Father," Kontakion of the Feast. "Lord, have mercy," 40. Glory and both now: "More honorable;" and 3 great prostrations. Immediately we begin Vespers; "O come, let us worship," thrice. Note: We sing Vespers without a Kathisma, and without prostrations.)*

"Lord, have mercy," 40. Glory and both now: "More honorable;" and 3 great prostrations. Immediately we begin Vespers; "O come, let us worship," thrice. Note: We sing Vespers without a Kathisma, and without prostrations.)*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *(Note: And at the 1st hour of the night, the great bell is struck, and all of them likewise. And we sing Great Compline. "God is with us," with both choirs. The priest censes at the beginning according to custom. And after "Glory to God in the highest," the procession into the narthex; and we sing at the Litiya the Stichera of the Feast; Glory and both now, of the Feast. At the Aposticha, Stichera; and Glory and both now, of the Feast. At the blessing of the loaves, Troparion of the Feast, thrice; and reading of the Feast. At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Feast, thrice. And after both Kathismata, Sessional Hymns of the Triodion; and reading of the day. After the 3rd Kathisma, Litany; and Sessional Hymns of the Feast, both; and reading of the Feast. Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymn, and reading of the Feast. Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon; "Every breath;" Gospel of the Feast. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 14. Katavasia of the Feast, the Heirmos, both choirs together. Note: But where there is a Triodion (three-ode canon): we sing the canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 6; and of the Triodion, on 8. Katavasia, the Heirmos of the Triodion. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the day, and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the refrains of the Feast, as was indicated beforehand. Exapostilarion of the Feast; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. At the Praises, Stichera of the Feast on 4; Glory, of the day, Tone 6: "Today Christ comes;" both now, of the Feast, Tone 2: "The mystery hidden from the ages." At the Aposticha, of the day, with their refrains, as was prescribed on Great Monday; Glory, of the Feast...)*

units.english_cohort_translation: *(Note: And at the 3rd hour of the day, we make the procession outside the monastery; and having returned, we sing the Hours with Kathismata; and the Tetra-Gospel is read. And the rest of the Hours and of the Liturgy, as was prescribed on Monday and Tuesday of this week. And at the end of the Hours there is mutual forgiveness in the monastery according to custom. And we sing Compline according to what was prescribed, and the Triodion (three-ode canon) of Lord Andrew of Crete.)*

At "Lord, I have cried," Idiomela Stichera of the day, 5; and of the Feast, 5; Glory, of the day; both now, of the Feast. Entrance with the Gospel. units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *In the evening, the bell is struck in the great bell and in all the heavy ones, at the 8th hour of the day; and we sing Great [Vespers]. At "Lord, I have cried," Idiomela Stichera of the day, 5; and of the Feast, 5; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. Entrance with the Gospel. "O gladsome Light;" and readings of the day; and of the Feast, 2. Small Litany; then Trisagion. Prokeimenon of the day, and of the Feast; Epistle of the day, and of the Feast. And the rest of the Liturgy of Basil the Great. Instead of "It is truly meet," the Heirmos: "Come, O ye faithful, let us enjoy the Master's hospitality." (Note: But in a temple of the Annunciation of the Most Holy Mother of God, the Heirmos: "As the animate [Ark].") And instead of the Cherubic Hymn, we sing the Troparion, Tone 6: "Of Thy mystical supper," thrice; the same we sing also instead of the Communion Hymn, once. And when the brethren receive Communion, we sing instead of "Receive the Body of Christ," the same: "Of Thy mystical supper;" and instead of "Let our mouths be filled," once, with Alleluias. (Note) In the refectory, we do not dispense for fish, but only for oil and wine.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в четверток вечера на гди воззвах стихиры дне
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ четверто́къ ве́чера, на гдⷭи воззва́хъ, стіхи̑ры днѐ, є҃: и҆ пра́здника, є҃. Сла́ва, днѐ, Рожде́нїе є҆хі́дново. И҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника, По́сланъ бы́сть. Вхо́дъ со є҆ѵⷢлїемъ. прокі́менъ, и҆ чте́нїе днѐ: и҆ пра́здника, г҃. Є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ. и҆ возгла́съ. и҆ трїст҃о́е. Прокі́менъ, а҆пл҃ъ, а҆λληлꙋ́їа, и҆ є҆ѵⷢлїе днѐ. и҆ про́чее бж҃твенныѧ лїтꙋргі́и, вели́кагѡ Васї́лїа, ꙗ҆́коже пре́жде и҆з̾ѧви́сѧ. На трапе́зѣ же разрѣша́емъ на є҆ле́й и҆ вїно̀. Повече́рїе пое́мъ ма́лое, съ трїпѣ́снцемъ. По трⷭто́мъ конда́къ днѐ: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника. При часѣ́ же пе́рвомъ но́щи, ᲂу҆дарѧ́етъ (Зрѝ) въ вели́кїй, и҆ во всѧ̑ тѧ̑жкаѧ, и҆ начина́емъ ᲂу҆́тренню. На Бг҃ъ Гдⷭь, тропа́рь пра́здника, два́жды: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, днѐ: Є҆гда̀ сла́внїи ᲂу҆чени́цы. Посе́мъ, є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ. И҆ а҆́бїе дїа́конъ

Прокі́менъ, а҆пл҃ъ, а҆λληлꙋ́їа, и҆ є҆ѵⷢлїе днѐ. и҆ про́чее бж҃твенныѧ лїтꙋргі́и, вели́кагѡ Васї́лїа, ꙗ҆́коже пре́жде и҆з̾ѧви́сѧ. На трапе́зѣ же разрѣша́емъ на є҆ле́й и҆ вїно̀. Повече́рїе пое́мъ ма́лое, съ трїпѣ́снцемъ. По трⷭто́мъ конда́къ днѐ: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника. При часѣ́ же пе́рвомъ но́щи, ᲂу҆дарѧ́етъ (Зрѝ) въ вели́кїй, и҆ во всѧ̑ тѧ̑жкаѧ, и҆ начина́емъ ᲂу҆́тренню. На Бг҃ъ Гдⷭь, тропа́рь пра́здника, два́жды: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, днѐ: Є҆гда̀ сла́внїи ᲂу҆чени́цы. Посе́мъ, є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ. И҆ а҆́бїе дїа́конъ

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source: *On Thursday evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the day, 5; and of the Feast, 5; Glory, of the day: "Offspring of vipers;" both now, of the Feast: "Was sent [the Archangel Gabriel]." Entrance with the Gospel. Prokeimenon, and readings of the day; and of the Feast, 3. Small Litany, and exclamation, and the Trisagion. Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel of the day; and the rest of the Divine Liturgy of Basil the Great, as was explained previously. In the refectory, we dispense for oil and wine. We sing Small Compline with the Triodion (three-ode canon). After the Trisagion, Kontakion of the day; Glory and both now, of the Feast.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...or priest says: "And that we may be accounted worthy to hear the Holy Gospel." And the Superior reads the 1st Gospel; and afterwards the Antiphons, and the Gospels of the Holy Passions, according to their order. And after the reading of the 7th Gospel, the reading of the day. After this, Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon of the Feast; "Every breath;" Gospel of the Feast; and immediately the 8th Gospel of the Holy Passions. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Then the prayer: "O God, save Thy people;" and we: "Lord, have mercy," 12. Canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 14. Katavasia of the Feast, both choirs together. But where there is a Triodion (three-ode canon): we sing the canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 6, the Heirmos twice; and the Triodion on 8; Katavasia, the Heirmos of the Triodion, both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the day, and Ikos; Glory and both now, Sessional Hymn of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos, and Synaxarion. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the Refrain of the Feast. Exapostilarion of the Feast; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. Then the 9th Gospel. At the Praises, Idiomela Stichera of the day; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. Then the 10th Gospel. After this, "Glory to God in the highest;" Litany: "Let us complete our morning prayer;" and exclamation. After this, the 11th Gospel. Then at the Aposticha, Stichera of the Feast; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. Then the 12th Gospel. After this: "It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord;"[^396] and after "Our Father," Troparion, Tone 4: "Thou hast redeemed us [from the curse of the law];"[^397] Glory and both now, of the Feast. Litany: "Have mercy on us, O God." Priest: "Wisdom;" and dismissal. And we sing the 1st Hour as was indicated on Great Friday: we say at it the Troparion of the Feast, and of the day, and the Kontakion of the Feast.*

units.slavonic_incipit: дїа́конъ, и҆лѝ їере́й гл҃етъ: И҆ ѡ҆
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: диакон или иерей глет и о сподобитися нам
units.slavonic_diplomatic: дїа́конъ, и҆лѝ їере́й гл҃етъ: И҆ ѡ҆ сподо́битисѧ на́мъ слы́шанїа ст҃а́гѡ є҆ѵа́глїа. и҆ чте́тъ є҆ѵа́глїе а҃-е, настоѧ́тель. и҆ пото́мъ а҆нті́фѡны: и҆ є҆ѵа́глїа ст҃ы́хъ страсте́й, по чи́нꙋ и҆́хъ. и҆ по чте́нїи з҃-гѡ є҆ѵа́глїа, чте́нїе днѐ. По се́мъ степе́нна, а҃-й а҆нті́фѡнъ, д҃-гѡ гла́са. Прокі́менъ праз. всѧ́кое дыха́нїе: є҆ѵа́глїе праз: и҆ а҆́бїе є҆ѵа́глїе ст҃ы́хъ страсте́й, ѻ҆смо́е. Ѱало́мъ н҃. стіхи́ра праз. Та́же мл҃тва, Спасѝ бж҃е лю́ди твоѧ̑: и҆ мы̀, Гдⷭи поми́лꙋй, в҃і. Канѡ́нъ пра́здника, со і҆рмосо́мъ на д҃і. Катава́сїа, прл, ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. А҆ и҆дѣ́же трїпѣ́снецъ: пое́мъ канѡ́нъ пра́здника со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃: і҆рмо́съ два̀: и҆ трїпѣ́снецъ на и҃: Катава́сїа, і҆рмо́съ трїѡ́ди, ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. По г҃ пѣ́сни, конда́къ днѐ, и҆ і҆́косъ: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, сѣда́ленъ пра́зд: и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни, конда́къ пра́здника, и҆ і҆́косъ, и҆ сѷнаѯа́рїй. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни, честнѣ́йшꙋю не пое́мъ, но пое́мъ припѣ́въ пра́здника. Свѣти́ленъ пра́здника, сла́ва днѐ, и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. Та́же є҆ѵа́глїе ѳ҃-е. На хвали́техъ, стіхи̑ры самогла́сны днѐ: сла́ва днѐ, и҆ нн҃ѣ пра́здника. та́же є҆ѵа́глїе і҃-е. посе́мъ, Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ: є҆кте́нїа, И҆спо́лнимъ ᲂу҆́треннюю мл҃твꙋ: и҆ возгла́съ. Посе́мъ, є҆ѵа́глїе, а҃і-е. Та́же на стіхо́внѣ стіхи̑ры пра́здника: сла́ва днѐ: и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. та́же є҆ѵа́глїе, в҃і-е. Посе́мъ, Бл҃го є҆́сть и҆сповѣ́датися гдⷭви: И҆ по Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ, тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃: И҆скꙋпи́лъ ны̀ є҆сѝ: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника. Є҆ктені́а, Поми́лꙋй на́съ бж҃е: Їере́й, премꙋ́дрость. и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ ча́съ а҃-й пое́мъ ꙗ҆́коже ᲂу҆каза́сѧ въ вели́кїй пѧто́къ: гла́големъ же на не́мъ, тропа́рь пра́здника, и҆ днѐ, и҆ конда́къ пра́здника. При часѣ́ же є҃-мъ днѐ, твори́мъ и҆схожде́нїе внѣ̀ ѻ҆би́тели: и҆ возвра́щшесѧ, пое́мъ г҃-й ча́съ, и҆ ѕ҃-й, и҆ ѳ҃-й, съ тропари̑, и҆ паремі́и, со а҆плы, и҆ є҆ѵа́глїи, и҆ чте́нїѧми: и҆ со про́чею слꙋ́жбою и҆́хъ. глаго́лютсѧ же въ ни́хъ тропа́рь часѡ́въ вели́кагѡ пѧтка̀, є҆́же є҆́сть днѐ: и҆ пра́здника. конда́къ днѐ, и҆ пра́здника: и҆ прѡ́чїѧ, ꙗ҆́коже въ вели́кїй пѧто́къ ᲂу҆каза́сѧ, ѱало́мъ же л҃г здѣ̀ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ: и҆ глаго́лемъ є҆го̀ на лїтꙋргі́и. При часѣ́ же н҃-мъ днѐ, зна́менаетъ въ вели́кїй и҆ во всѧ̑ тѧ̑жкаѧ, начина́емъ вече́рню, и҆ твори́тъ їере́й проскоми́дїю. На гдⷭи воззва́хъ, пое́мъ стіхи̑ры днѐ, ѕ҃: и҆ пра́здника, д҃. Сла́ва, днѐ, Всѧ́къ законопрестꙋ́пный собо́ръ: и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника, По́сланъ бы́сть: Вхо́дъ со є҆ѵа́лїемъ. Свѣ́те ти́хїй. прокі́менъ, и҆ чте́нїе днѐ: и҆ пра́здника, в҃.

На хвали́техъ, стіхи̑ры самогла́сны днѐ: сла́ва днѐ, и҆ нн҃ѣ пра́здника. та́же є҆ѵа́глїе і҃-е. посе́мъ, Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ: є҆кте́нїа, И҆спо́лнимъ ᲂу҆́треннюю мл҃твꙋ: и҆ возгла́съ. Посе́мъ, є҆ѵа́глїе, а҃і-е. Та́же на стіхо́внѣ стіхи̑ры пра́здника: сла́ва днѐ: и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. та́же є҆ѵа́глїе, в҃і-е. Посе́мъ, Бл҃го є҆́сть и҆сповѣ́датися гдⷭви: И҆ по Ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ, тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃: И҆скꙋпи́лъ ны̀ є҆сѝ: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника. Є҆ктені́а, Поми́лꙋй на́съ бж҃е: Їере́й, премꙋ́дрость. и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ ча́съ а҃-й пое́мъ ꙗ҆́коже ᲂу҆каза́сѧ въ вели́кїй пѧто́къ: гла́големъ же на не́мъ, тропа́рь пра́здника, и҆ днѐ, и҆ конда́къ пра́здника. При часѣ́ же є҃-мъ днѐ, твори́мъ и҆схожде́нїе внѣ̀ ѻ҆би́тели: и҆ возвра́щшесѧ, пое́мъ г҃-й ча́съ, и҆ ѕ҃-й, и҆ ѳ҃-й, съ тропари̑, и҆ паремі́и, со а҆плы, и҆ є҆ѵа́глїи, и҆ чте́нїѧми: и҆ со про́чею слꙋ́жбою и҆́хъ. глаго́лютсѧ же въ ни́хъ тропа́рь часѡ́въ вели́кагѡ пѧтка̀, є҆́же є҆́сть днѐ: и҆ пра́здника. конда́къ днѐ, и҆ пра́здника: и҆ прѡ́чїѧ, ꙗ҆́коже въ вели́кїй пѧто́къ ᲂу҆каза́сѧ, ѱало́мъ же л҃г здѣ̀ ѡ҆ставлѧ́емъ: и҆ глаго́лемъ є҆го̀ на лїтꙋргі́и. При часѣ́ же н҃-мъ днѐ, зна́менаетъ въ вели́кїй и҆ во всѧ̑ тѧ̑жкаѧ, начина́емъ вече́рню, и҆ твори́тъ їере́й проскоми́дїю. На гдⷭи воззва́хъ, пое́мъ стіхи̑ры днѐ, ѕ҃: и҆ пра́здника, д҃. Сла́ва, днѐ, Всѧ́къ законопрестꙋ́пный собо́ръ: и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника, По́сланъ бы́сть: Вхо́дъ со є҆ѵа́лїемъ. Свѣ́те ти́хїй. прокі́менъ, и҆ чте́нїе днѐ: и҆ пра́здника, в҃.
units.english_text: *...or priest says: "And that we may be accounted worthy to hear the Holy Gospel." And the Superior reads the 1st Gospel; and afterwards the Antiphons, and the Gospels of the Holy Passions, according to their order. And after the reading of the 7th Gospel, the reading of the day. After this, Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon of the Feast; "Every breath;" Gospel of the Feast; and immediately the 8th Gospel of the Holy Passions. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Then the prayer: "O God, save Thy people;" and we: "Lord, have mercy," 12. Canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 14. Katavasia of the Feast, both choirs together. But where there is a Triodion (three-ode canon): we sing the canon of the Feast with the Heirmos on 6, the Heirmos twice; and the Triodion on 8; Katavasia, the Heirmos of the Triodion, both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the day, and Ikos; Glory and both now, Sessional Hymn of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos, and Synaxarion. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the Refrain of the Feast. Exapostilarion of the Feast; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. Then the 9th Gospel. At the Praises, Idiomela Stichera of the day; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. Then the 10th Gospel. After this, "Glory to God in the highest;" Litany: "Let us complete our morning prayer;" and exclamation. After this, the 11th Gospel. Then at the Aposticha, Stichera of the Feast; Glory, of the day; and both now, of the Feast. Then the 12th Gospel. After this: "It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord;"[^396] and after "Our Father," Troparion, Tone 4: "Thou hast redeemed us [from the curse of the law];"[^397] Glory and both now, of the Feast. Litany: "Have mercy on us, O God." Priest: "Wisdom;" and dismissal. And we sing the 1st Hour as was indicated on Great Friday: we say at it the Troparion of the Feast, and of the day, and the Kontakion of the Feast.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *And at the 5th hour of the day, we make the procession outside the monastery; and having returned, we sing the 3rd Hour, the 6th, and the 9th, with Troparia, and Paremias, with the Epistles, and Gospels, and readings, and with their remaining service. And at them are said the Troparion of the Hours of Great Friday, which is of the day, and of the Feast; Kontakion of the day, and of the Feast; and the rest as was indicated on Great Friday. But Psalm 33 we omit here, and say it at the Liturgy. And at the 8th hour of the day, the bell is struck in the great bell and in all the heavy ones; we begin Vespers, and the priest performs the Proskomedia. At "Lord, I have cried," we sing Stichera of the day, 6; and of the Feast, 4; Glory, of the day: "The whole assembly of transgressors;" both now, of the Feast: "Was sent [the Archangel Gabriel]." Entrance with the Gospel. "O gladsome Light." Prokeimenon, and readings of the day; and of the Feast, 2. Then... ...Small Litany, and the Trisagion. Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel, first of the Feast, and of the day. Communion Hymn of the Feast. And the Divine Liturgy of Chrysostom is celebrated. Instead of "It is truly meet," we sing the Heirmos of the Feast: "As the animate [Ark]." In the refectory, we eat dry food (xerophagy), and drink wine.*

Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel, first of the Feast, and of the day. Communion Hymn of the Feast. And the Divine Liturgy of Chrysostom is celebrated. Instead of "It is truly meet," we sing the Heirmos of the Feast: "As the animate [Ark]." In the refectory, we eat dry food (xerophagy), and drink wine.

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *(Note: And at the 1st hour of the night, the bell is struck in the great bell and in all the heavy ones; and we sing Matins. At "God is the Lord," Troparion of the day, Tone 2: "The noble Joseph," once; "When Thou didst descend unto death," once; Glory: "Unto the Myrrh-bearing women;" and both now, of the Feast: "Today is the fountainhead of our salvation." Then we sing the Blameless (Kathisma 17), in Tone 5. The priest censes at the 1st "Glory," likewise also at the 2nd and at the 3rd, according to custom. At the conclusion of the Blameless, we sing the Resurrectional Troparia: "The assembly of angels," and the rest. Then Small Litany, and Sessional Hymn of the day; then Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymn of the Feast, and reading of the Feast. Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon of the Feast; "Every breath;" Gospel of the Feast. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon of the Feast, with the Heirmos on 8; the Heirmos twice; and of the day, with the Heirmos on 8. Katavasia, the Heirmos of the day, both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the day and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of the day; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos, Prologue, and Synaxarion. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable," but sing the refrains of the Feast, as was indicated. Afterwards, Heirmos of the day: "Weep not for Me, O Mother;" then Refrain of the Feast, and Heirmos. "Holy is the Lord our God,"[^398] in Tone 2. Exapostilarion...)*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...Exapostilarion of the Feast, twice. At the Praises, Stichera, Idiomela of the day, 3; and of the Feast, Prosomoia, 3; then Idiomelon of the Feast, Tone 8: "Let the heavens rejoice," with the refrain: "Proclaim from day to day the salvation of our God;"[^399] Glory, of the day; and both now: "Most blessed art thou." Great Doxology. And the entrance takes place as written in the Triodion. After this, Prokeimenon and Paremia of the day. Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel of the day. Litany, and dismissal. And the 1st Hour we sing in the narthex; and the remaining Hours are sung at their proper time.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Hours, Troparion of the Feast, and of the day; we say the Kontakia, alternating them. The Beatitudes quickly, without singing: "Remember us, O Lord," and the rest. After "Our Father," Kontakion of the day; Glory and both now, Kontakion of the Feast. "Lord, have mercy," 40; and prayer: "O All-Holy Trinity;" and dismissal.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At "Lord, I have cried," we sing Stichera: Resurrectional, 3, Tone 1: "Accept our evening prayers;" and of Great Saturday, Idiomela, 3, Tone 8; and of the Feast, on 4. Glory, of the day, Tone 6: "This present day mystically;" and both now, of the Feast: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance with the Gospel. "O gladsome Light." We do not say the Prokeimenon, but immediately the priest says: "Wisdom;" and the readings of the day, according to their order. And at the conclusion of the readings, Small Litany, and exclamation. And instead of the Trisagion, we sing: "As many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia."[^400] Prokeimenon of the day, and of the Feast. Epistle of the day, and of the Feast. And instead of the Cherubic Hymn, there is sung: "Let all mortal flesh keep silence;"[^401] and in order the Divine Liturgy of Basil the Great. Instead of "It is truly meet," we sing the Heirmos: "Weep not for Me, O Mother." But in a temple of the Annunciation of the Mother of God, we sing the Heirmos: "As the animate [Ark]." Communion Hymn of the day, and of the Feast.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Great Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried," we set 10 verses; and we sing Resurrectional Stichera, 3; and of Great Saturday, 3; and of the Feast, 4. Glory, Tone 6: "This present day mystically;" and both now, of the Feast, the same Tone: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance with the Gospel. "O gladsome Light." The Prokeimenon is not said, but immediately the priest says: "Wisdom;"... ...Wisdom. And the readings: 1st reading of the day: "In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth:"[^403] one Paremia. Then of the Feast of the Annunciation, 5 readings. Then also the remaining readings of the day, according to their order. And in order the Divine Liturgy of Basil the Great. And after the dismissal of the Liturgy, there is eating, and the reading of the Acts of the Holy Apostles according to their order, as was indicated on Great Saturday. And the reading having finished, the priest having given the blessing, we say the Trisagion; and after "Our Father," "Lord, have mercy," 12; Glory and both now: "O come, let us worship," thrice. Then Psalm 50. And we sing the Canon of the Feast, with the Heirmos on 6; and of Great Saturday, with the Heirmos on 8. Katavasia, the Saturday Heirmos, both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, and Sessional Hymn of the day; Glory and both now, of the Feast; and reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the day, and Ikos; and reading of the day. After Ode 9, the Trisagion; and after "Our Father," Troparion: "When Thou didst descend unto death;" Glory and both now, of the Feast. Litany, and dismissal.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF MARCH :: Likewise also on all the Sundays of the Holy Fasts in which this Feast happens to fall, the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great is celebrated without variation
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *And if there is time early, the reading of the day is added; while it is being read, the Superior distributes candles to the brethren. The lamplighter, having taken the blessing from the Superior, goes and strikes in all [the bells]. And after the reading, we go out into the narthex, with lamps preceding the Superior; and the doors having been shut, he censes the entire brotherhood according to rank. And standing before the great church doors, he censes in the form of a cross, thrice, and says: "Glory to the holy, and consubstantial;" and we having answered: "Amen." And the Superior begins the Troparion, Tone 5: "Christ is risen from the dead," thrice. Then the brethren sing it thrice. Superior, verse 1: "Let God arise;"[^404] and the brethren: "Christ is risen," once. Superior, verse 2: "As smoke vanishes;"[^405] and the brethren: "Christ is risen," once. Superior, verse 3: "So let the sinners perish;"[^406] and the brethren: "Christ is risen," once. Superior, verse 4: "This is the day which the Lord hath made;"[^407] and the brethren: "Christ is risen," once. And immediately the Superior with a loud voice: "Christ is risen;" and he opens the doors, and the Superior enters with the precious cross, with lamps preceding him, and the brethren singing: "And upon those in the tombs bestowing life." And when he enters into the sanctuary, we say "Glory," and sing the Troparion of the Feast, Tone 4: "Today is the fountainhead of our salvation;" and both now, the same. Then the Litany... ...Great Litany: "In peace let us pray to the Lord." And after the exclamation, the Superior begins the Heirmos: "The Day of Resurrection;" and we sing the Canon of Pascha with the Heirmos on 8, the heirmoi twice; and the Canon of the Annunciation with the Heirmos on 8, the heirmoi twice. And afterwards the heirmoi of both choirs, each choir its own; then Katavasia: "The Day of Resurrection," both choirs together; and the Troparion: "Christ is risen," thrice. And after each ode, Small Litany, and exclamations according to their order. After Ode 3, Kontakion and Ikos of Pascha, and the Hypakoe; and the reading in the Theologian, whereof the beginning is: "I will stand upon my watch."[^408] After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Feast of the Annunciation, and Ikos; and the reading also in the Theologian, whereof the beginning is: "It is the Day of Resurrection."[^409] Then Prokeimenon of the Feast, Tone 4: "Proclaim from day to day;" verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song." "Every breath;" Gospel from Luke, pericope 4: "In those days, Mary arose."[^410] Then: "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ," thrice; and the Sticheron: "Jesus having risen," thrice, in Tone 6. After this, Ode 7 and the remaining two. At Ode 9, we sing the refrains of Pascha, and of the Feast. Exapostilarion of Pascha, once; and of the Feast, twice. At the Praises, Resurrectional Stichera on 4; and of the Annunciation on 4, with their verses; then both choirs together, 1st verse: "Let God arise;" Stichera of Pascha, Tone 5, with their remaining verses; Glory, of the Annunciation, Tone 8: "Let the heavens rejoice;" and both now, of Pascha: "The Day of Resurrection." And the kissing (Paschal greeting) according to custom. And the homily of Chrysostom. Litanies, and dismissal. The procession outside the monastery does not take place. The Hours are sung according to the Typikon of Pascha. At the Liturgy, the Antiphons of Pascha. And after the Entrance we say: "In the congregations bless ye God, the Lord from the springs of Israel."[^411] "Christ is risen," thrice; Glory, Troparion: "Today is the fountainhead of our salvation;" and both now, Kontakion: "Though Thou didst descend into the grave." Instead of the Trisagion, we sing: "As many of you as have been baptized into Christ." Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel: first of Pascha, then of the Feast.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *(Note: And when the time arrives at the Liturgy to read the Holy Gospel, the priest reads the Gospel of Pascha with the deacon, as was indicated at the Liturgy on Sunday. Then a single deacon reads the Gospel of the Annunciation according to custom, as always. And for that Gospel they do not strike in the bell. And in order the Divine Liturgy of Chrysostom. units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers, while the priest censes, and when he says: "Glory to the holy, and consubstantial;" he sings: "Christ is risen," thrice, and its verses; Glory and both now: "Christ is risen," thrice; then Litany. At "Lord, I have cried," Resurrectional Stichera, 3; and Anatolian (Eastern), 1; and of the Feast, 6. Glory and both now, of the Feast: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Entrance. "O gladsome Light." Prokeimenon, Tone 7: "Who is a great God like our God," with its verses. And 5 readings of the Feast. (If on Sunday evening, after this the priest says: "And that we may be accounted worthy;" Gospel according to John, pericope 65: "The same day at evening;" ending: "I will not believe.")[^413] Then Litany. At the Litiya, Idiomela Stichera of the Feast; Glory and both now: "Gabriel announces the glad tidings." At the Aposticha, Resurrectional Sticheron, 1; then the refrain: "Let God arise;" and we sing the Stichera of Pascha, with their refrains; Glory, of the Feast: "Today is the joy;" and both now, of Pascha: "The Day of Resurrection;" and at the end: "Christ is risen," thrice. Troparion of the Feast, thrice; and blessing of the loaves, and distribution, and reading of the Feast.*

units.slavonic_incipit: Во ст҃ꙋ́ю и҆ вели́кꙋю недѣ́лю па́схи:
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: во стую и великую неделю пасхи на малей
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Во ст҃ꙋ́ю и҆ вели́кꙋю недѣ́лю па́схи: На ма́лѣй вече́рни, по внегда̀ рещѝ і҆ере́ю: Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се, три́жды, и҆ сті́хи ѻ҆бы̑чныѧ: Сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се. На гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, стры̑ воскрⷭ҇ны, на д҃. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника, гла́съ, в҃. Е҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка та́инство: та́же, Свѣ́те ти́хїй без̾ вхо́да. Прокі́менъ вели́кїй, Кто̀ бг҃ъ ве́лїй, и҆ сті́хъ є҆гѡ̀. та́же, Сподо́би гдⷭ҇и. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи́ра воскрⷭ҇на, а҃: та́же, стїхи̑ры пра́здника, самогла́сны г҃, гла́съ д҃, вели́кїѧ вече́рни стїхо́вныѧ, съ припѣ́вы и҆́хъ. Сла́ва, Бл҃говѣствꙋ́етъ гаврїи́лъ: и҆ ны́нѣ, Воскрⷭ҇нїа де́нь: Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се: три́жды. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: тропа́рь: Дне́сь спасенїа на́шегѡ. є҆кте́нїа ма́лаѧ, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ.

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins: after the priest gives the blessing, and says: "Christ is risen," thrice, and its verses; and after the conclusion, Glory, Troparion of the Feast; and both now, the same; then Great Litany; and Polyeleos, and Sessional Hymns, and reading of the Feast. Gradual Hymns, the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4; Prokeimenon and Gospel of the Feast. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ," thrice. Psalm 50 we do not say; but immediately: Glory: "Through the intercessions of the Mother of God;" and both now, the same. Then the refrain in Tone 6: "Proclaim from day to day;" and we sing the Idiomelon Sticheron... ...Idiomelon Sticheron of the Feast, Tone 6: "The Archangel Gabriel was sent." Then the priest says the prayer: "O God, save Thy people;" "Lord, have mercy," 12. And after the exclamation, we sing the Canon of Pascha with the Heirmos on 6; and of the Feast with the Heirmos on 8; Heirmoi of Pascha and of the Feast, twice each. Katavasia of the Annunciation, the Heirmos, both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion and Ikos of Pascha, and Sessional Hymn of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast; and readings of the day. Then: "Jesus having risen," thrice. At Ode 9, refrains of Pascha, and of the Feast. Exapostilarion of Pascha, 1; and of the Feast, twice. At the Praises, Stichera of the Tone, 3; and of the Feast, Prosomoia, 3; then: "Let God arise;" and we sing the Stichera of Pascha with their refrains; Glory, of the Feast: "Let the heavens rejoice;" and both now, of Pascha: "The Day of Resurrection." "Christ is risen," thrice; Glory and both now, Troparion of the Feast. Litanies, and dismissal. And the holy oil is given to the brethren. And the Litiya takes place outside the monastery. The Hours we sing of Pascha according to custom.*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: На вели́цѣй вече́рни, по внегда̀ кади́ти і҆ере́ю, и҆ рещѝ є҆мꙋ̀: Сла́ва ст҃ѣ́й и҆ є҆диносꙋ́щнѣй: пое́тъ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се, три́жды, и҆ сті́хи є҆гѡ̀. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се, три́жды: та́же є҆кте́нїа. На гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, стїхи̑ры воскрⷭ҇ны г҃: и҆ восто́ченъ є҆ди́нъ. и҆ пра́здника, ѕ҃. Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника: Посла́нъ бы́сть. Вхо́дъ. Свѣ́те ти́хїй. прокі́менъ, гла́съ, з҃: Кто̀ бг҃ъ ве́лїй ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ на́шъ: со стїхѝ є҆гѡ̀. И҆ чте́нїй пра́здника, є҃. (А҆́ще въ недѣ́лю ве́чера, посе́мъ і҆ере́и, и҆ ѡ҆ сподо́битися на́мъ: є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе ѿ і҆ѡа́нна, зача́ло, ѯ҃є: Сꙋ́щꙋ по́здѣ въ де́нь то́й. Коне́цъ: Не и҆́мꙋ вѣ́ры:) Та́же є҆кте́нїа. На лїті́и стїхи̑ры самогла́сны пра́здника: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, Бл҃говѣствꙋ́етъ гаврїи́лъ. На стїхо́внѣ стїхи́ра воскрⷭ҇на є҆ди́на. Та́же припѣ́въ: Да воскрⷭ҇нетъ бг҃ъ: и҆ пое́мъ стїхи̑ры па́схи, со припѣ̑вы и҆́хъ. Сла́ва, пра́здника: Дне́сь ра́дость: и҆ ны́нѣ па́схи, Воскресе́нїа де́нь: и҆ на коне́цъ, Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се, три. тропа́рь пра́здника, три́жды. и҆ бл҃гослове́нїе хлѣ́бѡвъ, и҆ раздаѧ́нїе, и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. На ᲂу҆́тренни: по внегда̀ бл҃гослови́ти і҆ере́ю, и҆ рещѝ: Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се, три́жды, и҆ сті́хи є҆гѡ̀. и҆ по сконча́нїи, сла́ва тропа́рь пра́з: и҆ ннѣ̀ то́йже. та́же є҆кте́нїа вели́каѧ. и҆ полѷеле́й, и҆ сѣда́льны, и҆ чте́нїе пра́здника. Степе́нна, а҃-й а҆нтїфѡ́нъ, д҃-гѡ гла́са: прокі́менъ, и҆ є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе пра́здника. Воскрⷭ҇нїе хрⷭ҇то́во, три́жды. Ѱало́мъ, н҃, не гле́мъ: но а҆́бїе, Сла́ва, Моли́твами бцⷣы: и҆ ны́нѣ то́йже. Посе́мъ припѣ́въ на гла́съ, ѕ҃. Бл҃говѣсти́те де́нь ѿ днѐ: и҆ пое́мъ стїхи́рꙋ самогла́снꙋ гла́снꙋ пра́здника, гла́съ, ѕ҃: Посла́нъ бы́сть: Та́же і҆ере́й глаго́летъ мл҃твꙋ: Сп҃сѝ бж҃е лю́ди твоѧ̑: Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, в҃і. И҆ по возгла́сѣ, пое́мъ канѡ́нъ па́схи, со і҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃: и҆ пра́з, со і҆рмосо́мъ на и҃. І҆рмосы па́схи, и҆ пра́здника, по два́жды. Катава́сїа бл҃говѣ́щенїа, і҆рмо́съ, ѻ҆́ба ли́ка вкꙋ́пѣ. По г҃-й пѣ́сни, конда́къ па́схи, и҆ і҆́косъ, и҆ сѣда́ленъ пра́здника. По ѕ҃-й пѣ́сни, конда́къ пра́здника, и҆ і҆́косъ: и҆ чте́нїа днѐ. Та́же, Воскре́съ і҆и҃съ: три́жды. На ѳ҃-й пѣ́сни, припѣ́вы па́схи, и҆ пра́з: Свѣти́ленъ па́схи, а҃: и҆ пра́здника два́жды. На хвали́техъ стїхи̑ры воскрⷭ҇ны гла́са, г҃: и҆ пра́здника подо́бны, г҃. та́же, Да воскрⷭ҇нетъ бг҃ъ: и҆ пое́мъ стїхи̑ры па́схи, съ припѣ́вы и҆́хъ. Сла́ва, пра́з: Да весе́лѧтсѧ нб҃са̀: и҆ ны́нѣ па́схи: Воскресе́нїа де́нь. Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се, г҃: сла́ва и҆ ны́нѣ, тропа́рь пра́здника. Є҆ктенїѝ. И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. И҆ даетсѧ ст҃ый є҆ле́й бра́тїи. И҆ быва́етъ лїтїа̀ внѣ̀ ѻ҆би́тели. Часы́ же пое́мъ па́схи по ѻ҆бы́чаю.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: на литургии антифоны пасхи по входе глаголем стих
units.slavonic_diplomatic: На лїтꙋргі́и а҆нтїфѡ́ны па́схи. По вхо́дѣ, глаго́лемъ сті́хъ: Въ цр҃квахъ бл҃гослови́те бг҃а гдⷭ҇а, Хрⷭ҇то́съ воскре́се. три́жды: Тропа́рь пра́здника: Сла́ва, конда́къ па́схи, и҆ ны́нѣ пра́здника. Вмѣ́стѡ трїст҃а́гѡ, Е҆ли́цы во хрⷭ҇та̀ крⷭ҇ти́стесѧ. Прокі́менъ, а҆́пл҃ъ, а҆λληлꙋ́їа, и҆ є҆ѵⷢ҇лїе: пре́жде бл҃говѣ́щенїа, та́же днѐ. И҆ порѧ́дꙋ бж҃ественнаѧ лїтꙋргі́а златоꙋ́стагѡ. Прича́стенъ днѐ, и҆ пра́здника.

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *(Note: And let it be known that not by our own discretion [did we determine] how the service of the Annunciation ought to be sung during the days of the Holy Forty Days, and in the week of the Great Sunday, on Holy Pascha, and what hath been commanded concerning this. For having closely followed the Typikon of the Great Church, and having examined the Synaxaria of the venerable Studite monastery and of others; and not only so, but having gone through the Jerusalem Typika, we have established these things. Let no one therefore marvel at the changes that take place—both in Stichera and Canons, and in readings, Prokeimena and Epistles, Alleluias and Gospels, and Communion Hymns—which have been commanded so to be changed; but let him examine the day on which the Paramon (Eve) of the Annunciation falls, and likewise the day of the Feast itself; and thou shalt find that when the Paramon falls on a fasting day, for the sake of the honor of the Holy Forty Days we sing the Stichera of the day, and afterwards of the Annunciation, and the Liturgy of the Presanctified. And from that point the Feast takes its beginning, and all things precede...)*
